question: Who inaugurated the Fit India Carnival, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mansukh Mandaviya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Union Minister for **Youth Affairs and Sports**, **Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya**, officially inaugurated the **Fit India Carnival 2025**.
 
• The grand event was organized at the **Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium** in **New Delhi** on **January 10, 2025**.
 
• The carnival is a **three-day** celebration of fitness, wellness, and indigenous sports, scheduled to run from **January 10 to January 12, 2025**.
 
• The primary objective of this event is to further the vision of the **Fit India Movement** by encouraging **Jan Bhagidari** (public participation) in health-related activities.
